query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS soil_analyses (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  terroir_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  country VARCHAR(100),
  region VARCHAR(100),
  soil_type VARCHAR(100),
  soil_classification VARCHAR(200),
  ph_level DECIMAL(3,1),
  organic_matter_percent DECIMAL(5,2),
  nitrogen_content VARCHAR(100),
  phosphorus_content VARCHAR(100),
  potassium_content VARCHAR(100),
  calcium_content VARCHAR(100),
  magnesium_content VARCHAR(100),
  iron_content VARCHAR(100),
  drainage_quality VARCHAR(100),
  water_retention VARCHAR(100),
  altitude_meters INT,
  climate_type VARCHAR(100),
  annual_rainfall_mm INT,
  temperature_range VARCHAR(100),
  impact_on_tobacco TEXT,
  aromatic_influence TEXT,
  comparison_notes TEXT,
  source_references TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
